<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PlaneDelivery" name="Plane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams" processRef="Process_ManufacturingTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_Producer" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_ManufacturingTeams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Parts" name="Manufactured parts" sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PlaneDelivery" name="Plane delivery" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceivePlane" messageRef="Message_PlaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer customization and delivery" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customization begins"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SpecifyConfiguration" name="Specify bar, seat count, color and toilet water"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePlane" name="Receive plane" messageRef="Message_PlaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SpecifyConfiguration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SpecifyConfiguration" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceivePlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePlane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Luxury airplane production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Producer" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProducerStart" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Test flight and protocol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver plane to customer" messageRef="Message_PlaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Producer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_1" sourceRef="Start_Producer" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_4" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_7" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_8" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_10" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_11" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Producer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacture airplane parts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ManufacturingTeams" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ManufacturingStart" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureParts" name="Manufacture requested parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendParts" name="Send manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ManufacturingTeams" name="Parts sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_1" sourceRef="Start_ManufacturingTeams" targetRef="Task_ManufactureParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_2" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureParts" targetRef="Task_SendParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_3" sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="End_ManufacturingTeams"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
